    Details

Before web development, I worked as a freelance video editor, mostly editing gaming videos. After finishing my university studies in Mathematics and Informatics, I moved into web development and made it my career.

In 2019 I joined Pia Soft Product as a web developer and photo-video editor. I built presentation websites and online shops on WordPress and PrestaShop, handled SEO, website and hosting maintenance and client communication, and designed banners, logos and video ads. Apart from video editing, which I already knew, I learned everything on the job, working independently and building web applications with PHP, Smarty TPL, SQL, JavaScript, jQuery, HTML and CSS.

At the end of 2021 I moved full time to Netex Romania as a front-end developer, while staying part time at Pia Soft Product until late 2022. I maintained several WordPress websites and turned designs from Zeplin into static pages with HTML, SASS, Node.js, Bootstrap, JavaScript and jQuery. I started on my part of the project alone and later worked alongside a colleague, which taught me GitLab, Git and how to work well in a team.

In 2023 I took on shorter roles, as a junior WordPress developer at Enlivy and building a custom WordPress theme for Yes Agency. Since 2024 I have been working with Mentor Marketing Experts as a WordPress developer and web page designer, building Elementor websites from Figma designs, through Gi Group since April 2026.
